# scutum_group (Resource)

Manage a Scutum node group and its membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scutum_group" "production" {
  name        = "production"
  description = "All production edge nodes"
  node_ids = [
    scutum_node.edge_eu_west.id,
    scutum_node.edge_us_east.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `node_ids` (List of String) List of node IDs that are members of this group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
